mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.name, a.is_default AS "isDefault", a.base_balance AS "baseBalance", to_char(a.base_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "baseDate", a.base_balance + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN e.type = 'INCOME' THEN e.amount ELSE -e.amount END) FROM ledger_entry e WHERE e.user_id = a.user_id AND e.account_id = a.id ), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM account_transfer t WHERE t.user_id = a.user_id AND t.to_account_id = a.id ), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM account_transfer t WHERE t.user_id = a.user_id AND t.from_account_id = a.id ), 0) AS "balance" FROM bank_account a WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.is_default DESC, a.id
SELECT id, name, is_default AS "isDefault" FROM bank_account WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, id

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ledger_entry WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND account_id = #{id}) + (SELECT count(*) FROM recurring_item WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND account_id = #{id}) + (SELECT count(*) FROM account_transfer WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (from_account_id = #{id} OR to_account_id = #{id}))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bank_account (user_id, name, is_default, base_balance, base_date) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{isDefault}, #{baseBalance}, #{baseDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE bank_account SET name = #{name}, is_default = #{isDefault}, base_balance = #{baseBalance}, base_date = #{baseDate}, base_at = CASE WHEN base_balance = #{baseBalance} AND base_date = #{baseDate} THEN base_at ELSE now() END WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM bank_account WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, to_char(t.transfer_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "transferDate", t.amount, t.memo, t.from_account_id AS "fromAccountId", f.name AS "fromAccountName", t.to_account_id AS "toAccountId", ta.name AS "toAccountName", EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recurring_transfer_run r WHERE r.transfer_id = t.id) AS "recurring" FROM account_transfer t JOIN bank_account f ON f.id = t.from_account_id JOIN bank_account ta ON ta.id = t.to_account_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY t.transfer_date DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_transfer (user_id, transfer_date, from_account_id, to_account_id, amount, memo) VALUES (#{userId}, #{transferDate}, #{fromAccountId}, #{toAccountId}, #{amount}, #{memo})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM account_transfer WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.sql: r.id, r.amount, r.day_of_month AS "dayOfMonth", r.adjust, r.active, r.memo, r.from_account_id AS "fromAccountId", f.name AS "fromAccountName", r.to_account_id AS "toAccountId", ta.name AS "toAccountName"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM recurring_transfer r JOIN bank_account f ON f.id = r.from_account_id JOIN bank_account ta ON ta.id = r.to_account_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.active DESC, r.day_of_month, r.id

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM recurring_transfer WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}

mapper.update: UPDATE recurring_transfer_run SET transfer_id = #{transferId} WHERE recurring_transfer_id = #{recurringId} AND period_ym = #{periodYm}
